facts.text: Friars Meadow Car Park (Kingfisher Leisure Centre), Station Road, Sudbury CO10 2SS, is a long-stay car park with 297 spaces. Charges Monday to Saturday 8am to 6pm, excluding bank holidays: up to 2 hours £1.20, 3 hours £1.80, 4 hours £2.40, all day £3.00. The council's car park page does not mention the bathing site.
You can get into the water along the bank where the reeds have been cleared.

Defra's February 2024 designation consultation listed toilets in a local business, open to bathers, among the facilities near the site. It did not name the business. This is a 2024 listing, not a current check.
This stretch of the Stour is also popular with kayakers, paddleboarders and other recreational users.

The River Stour Trust owns the jetty at Friars Meadow and says its jetties are only for people in licensed craft navigating the river, not for other uses; it also asks people not to picnic or loiter on them. The trust's page does not mention the bathing site.
